notes.overview: Bahrain's short Paddock loop shares the GP's heavy-braking opening (T1-T5), then takes a tighter return loop home. Abrasive, low-grip tarmac punishes wheelspin and overheats fronts, so exits are traction-limited and tyre management matters. Reward smooth, straight braking into the big stops and progressive throttle out of the slow corners rather than aggressive rotation.

corners.1: The circuit's biggest stop. Brake hard and straight from the main straight, staying left on entry off the kerb; a compromised, patient exit sets up the immediate left of T2. Prime overtaking spot.
corners.2: Quick left flick straight after T1. Don't sacrifice it fighting for the T1 apex; roll speed and get the car pointed early to launch toward T3.
corners.3: Right kink taken near-flat as the track climbs toward the straight. Sacrifice nothing here, just carry speed and settle the car for the next braking zone.
corners.4: Heavy braking again at the end of the run. Wide entry allows alternate lines; take a mid-to-late apex, keep steering smooth to save the fronts, and use all the exit road.
corners.5: Left that opens the flowing section. Light braking or a lift depending on fuel and tyres; be smooth and progressive to keep the rear settled on the low-grip surface.
corners.6: Left in the return loop after a connecting run. Brake straight, take a clean single apex and prioritise a stable exit onto the following stretch.
corners.7: Right following T6. Position for a tidy line through here rather than overdriving entry; progressive throttle on exit to avoid wheelspin on the abrasive tarmac.
corners.8: Tight right, easy to lock up or run wide on worn tyres. Rotate the car first, then feed in throttle; short-shifting helps traction out.
corners.9: Right leading into the final complex. Combined braking and turning, so be measured on entry and keep the car stable for the linked T10.
corners.10: Last right before the line. Late apex and progressive throttle only, guarding against a wide exit that would cost you all the way down the straight.

notes.source: Bahrain International Circuit corner guides (Honda F1, RaceControl/Le Mans Ultimate wiki, Senate GP corner-by-corner, tracktitan.io); directions/apex positions taken from the app's computed corner map. T6-T10 return-loop notes grounded in geometry + Bahrain surface character; opening T1-T5 grounded in shared Bahrain GP knowledge.
